title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Parking Terms: The Weekly Basis Rate for Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elites (Guest Folios)
content:
Under the weekly parking maximum on Guest Folios, the weekly basis rate of an Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member is set by the member's tier.

**Terms.** Weekly basis rate: for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member the weekly basis rate is the brand's self-parking rate; for an Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite member it is the rate of the service parked on more nights, the valet rate when the valet lines are at least as many as the self-parking lines and the self-parking rate otherwise. For every other guest these terms set no basis rate of their own.

The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay; the self-parking lines and valet lines are those of the stay's folio, and the rates are the brand's self-parking and valet rates per night parked.

## Basis rate by tier

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Weekly basis rate |
|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | The brand's self-parking rate, whatever service was parked |
| Platinum Elite | The valet rate when the valet lines are at least as many as the self-parking lines; otherwise the self-parking rate |
| Any other tier, or no membership | No basis rate under these terms |

## Platinum Elite line counts (hypothetical stays)

| Self-parking lines | Valet lines | Weekly basis rate |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 5 | Valet rate |
| 4 | 4 | Valet rate (as many valet lines as self-parking lines) |
| 5 | 3 | Self-parking rate |
| 0 | 8 | Valet rate |

## Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite (hypothetical stay)

A stay with eight valet lines at a brand whose self-parking rate is $40.00 and valet rate $60.00 takes a weekly basis rate of $40.00, the brand's self-parking rate, for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member.
